purpose: Determine whether the q8 WebGPU browser candidate can execute a fixed 512-token synthetic input repeatedly in one browser/model session, separating the first forward from subsequent warm forwards, before any new ranking-quality experiment.

relationship_to_previous_experiment.previous_observation: 512 tokens passed; 2048 tokens failed with table index is out of bounds; 4096 was not run

synthetic_input_contract.base_query: What is the relation between being and knowledge?
synthetic_input_contract.base_document: Synthetic runtime feasibility document. This input exists only to exercise the browser runtime and is not part of any ranking evaluation.
synthetic_input_contract.construction: Use the pinned tokenizer and the same synthetic prompt contract as the prior feasibility experiment. Insert the preregistered one-token filler until total input length is exactly 512 tokens.

requirements: all six forwards complete without runtime exception
every input contains exactly 512 total tokens
every score is finite and in [0,1]
primary_gate.pass_rule: All 6 of 6 forwards must pass. Latency is observational only in this experiment.

failure_policy.after_failure: Freeze outputs, update EXPERIMENT_LOG.md, and preregister any subsequent runtime candidate separately.

success_policy.next_step: If and only if all six forwards pass, use the observed warm-runtime data to preregister a separate 512-token development ranking-quality experiment. Do not reuse the already-observed frozen ranking holdout.
